verdict.rationale: Kling's homepage makes a first-party claim of an 'MCP / CLI' offering that lets your agent power Kling (kling-docs-8), so the official-MCP-server axis applies and is nominally claimed. It is only a single marketing line, and nothing in the pack documents the server itself; the REST API (kling-docs-10) is a separate developer building block and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: MCP server documentation (install/endpoint, auth, exposed tools), evidence that it is official and generally available, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent connecting to it.
